statement.zh: 教科文与学术综合将廷巴克图、杰内等表述为西非萨赫勒中世纪商业—学术—城市网络的关键节点（UNESCO 119、116；Levtzion & Hopkins 2000）。
statement.en: UNESCO and scholarly syntheses frame Timbuktu, Djenné, and related nodes as key centres in West Africa's medieval Sahelian commercial–scholarly–urban networks (UNESCO 119, 116; Levtzion & Hopkins 2000).
